what_each_new_part_touches: Yellow box 1-3: two thin beams are joined by an axle pin, a blue pin links them with a 5-hole beam. The finished hinge plate goes on the lower end of the arm (arrow with a green arrow for the blue pin).
where_everything_is_after: a thin-beam hinge plate with a 5-hole beam is placed at the elbow

why.problem_solved: Builds the link at the elbow.
why.why_these_parts: Thin beams on an axle pin make a plate that can swing.
why.sets_up_for_later: Later steps hang the bucket cylinder on it.

review_note: Which holes are used is not countable.
